message.content: {"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && printf '%s\\n' '# tinydb milestones 1+2 - HANDOFF' '' 'Implementation: tinydb/journal.py -> BatchWriter(db) on the default table only.' '' 'R01: apply(ops) validates a list of op dicts (insert with Mapping document / remove with positive int doc_id); returns inserted IDs; empty -> []; malformed -> ValueError.' 'R02: atomic - deep-copied storage snapshot before batch; on any error restore default table data, reset table._next_id, clear_cache; missing remove id is an error; previously acquired handles reflect success and rollback.' 'R03: ordinary APIs unchanged; deep-copy on insert (no aliasing either way).' '' 'R04: bool doc_id rejected (isinstance bool check first); structural validation of the whole batch before any commit; non-list operations and non-dict documents raise ValueError; empty dict documents accepted.' 'R05: preview(ops) simulates on a deep-copied table snapshot read from storage; never writes, never consumes IDs (reads table._next_id without mutating; falls back to max(id)+1 like Table._get_next_id); errors leave data and next-ID unchanged; existing handles and query caches untouched (preview clears no cache). Storage keys are normalised from str to int (JSON storage).' 'R05b: preview and apply return fresh detached lists; mutating a returned list has no effect on later calls or writer state.' 'R05 clarification: successful apply advances the table _next_id counter (persisted via storage writes through _update_table); failed apply restores the counter, so IDs are never consumed by failures; subsequent inserts via apply or direct db.insert continue the sequence without reuse/rewind, even across removes.' 'R06: no stale snapshot - every call reads current storage; direct db.insert between calls is seen by apply and preview.' '' 'CONFLICT RESOLUTION: an older generated note claimed \"preview may consume IDs and bool IDs are accepted\". That note is unverified and superseded: preview NEVER consumes IDs (tested: test_preview_does_not_consume_ids, test_preview_on_error_consumes_nothing) and bool doc_ids are REJECTED (test_bool_doc_id_rejected). The happy-path smoke does not cover these boundaries; the tests above do.' '' 'Tests: tests/test_journal.py (123 tests, memory + JSON storage). Full suite tests/ + acceptance_public.py: 350 passed.' 'Run pytest with -o addopts= (pytest.ini adds coverage flags not installed here).' 'Note: use tinydb.where(...) for queries, not Query(...).' > HANDOFF.md && python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q -o addopts= 2>&1 | tail -3"}
